rules: Government, military and Tal Shiar presentation are separate layers.
Tal Shiar membership may be covert and must not be exposed visually unless the current scene/state permits it.
Romulan visual language must resolve era; 23rd-century and 24th-century uniforms/interiors are not one timeless style.
Species morphology cannot imply loyalty or intelligence affiliation.
forbidden_variation: automatic Tal Shiar uniform on secret members
forehead ridges used as organization markers
TNG-era military look backfilled into Kirk-era Romulans
